propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui, ad evangelizandum pauperibus et ecclesiastici ordinis decorem
promovendum, beatum Vincentium apostolica virtute roborasti: praesta,
quaesumus; ut, cujus pia merita veneramur, virtutum quoque instruamur
exemplis. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, Who didst strengthen blessed Vincent with apostolic virtue to preach the Gospel to the poor, and to promote the dignity befitting the ecclesiastical order, grant, we beseech Thee, that we, who venerate his holy merits, may be instructed by the example of his virtues. Through our Lord.

pro tuorum tibi grata sit honore Sanctorum, et nos corpore pariter et mente

et regnat.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui caelestia alimenta percepimus,
intercedente beato Vincentio Confessore tuo, per haec contra omnia adversa
muniamur. Per Dominum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Almighty God, we ask that, through the intercession of blessed Vincent your Confessor, we who have received heavenly food may be protected by it against all adversity. Through the Lord.
